learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn to use the concepts of limit, continuity, and derivative in single-variable functions.
Students will learn to plot function graphs by examining asymptotes, critical points, decreasing/increasing properties, and concavity.
Students will learn to formulate and solve maximum-minimum problems using derivatives.
Students will learn to calculate definite integrals using the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus and to calculate area, volume, and length with the help of definite integrals.
Students will learn to perform operations with transcendental functions and apply integration techniques.

syllabus_topics: Functions: Definition and Image Sets, Graph of a Function, Some Elementary Functions (Polynomials, Rational Functions, Algebraic Functions), Some Concepts Related to Functions (Even-Odd Function, Bounded Function, Increasing-Decreasing Functions, Implicit Function), Combination of Functions (Sum, Difference, Product and Quotient), Composite Functions, Piecewise Functions. Transcendental Functions: Trigonometric Functions

Inverse of a Function, Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Exponential and Logarithmic Functions, Hyperbolic-Inverse Hyperbolic Functions. Limit: Limit of a Function, One-sided Limits, Theorems on Limits (Limit Rules), Squeeze Theorem

Infinite Symbols and Limit. Continuity: Continuity at a Point, Continuity Over a Set, Types of Discontinuity, Intermediate Value and Extreme Value Theorems. Derivative: Derivative at a Point, Derivative as a Function, One-sided Derivatives, Derivative Over an Interval

Differentiability and Continuity, Rules of Differentiation, Higher Order Derivatives, Chain Rule, Derivative of an Implicit Function, Derivatives of Transcendental Functions, Tangent and Normal Lines, Linearization and Differentials.

Applications of the Derivative: Rolle's and Mean Value Theorems, Increasing-Decreasing Functions, Extreme Values of Functions: First and Second Derivative Tests, Indeterminate Forms, Concavity and Inflection Points, Asymptotes, Simple Curve Sketching.

Definite Integral: Antiderivatives, Sigma Notation and Limits of Finite Sums, Riemann Sums, Definite Integral, Properties of the Definite Integral, Area of the Region Bounded by a Curve, Mean Value Theorem for Definite Integrals.

Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part 1, Part 2), Indefinite Integral: Integration Table, Substitution in Indefinite-Definite Integrals [Calculation of some trigonometric integrals]. Integration Techniques: Integration by Parts.
Trigonometric Substitutions, Integrals of Rational Functions (Partial Fractions). Applications of the Definite Integral: Areas of Plane Regions (Two or more curves).
Volumes of Solids of Revolution: Disk Method-Washer Method, Cylindrical Shell Method, Arc Length, Areas of Surfaces of Revolution.
Improper Integrals: Type I and Type II Integrals.

Quiz. Parametric and Polar Curves: Polar Coordinates, Relationship Between Polar and Cartesian Coordinates, Introduction to Polar Curves (Lines, Circles, and Cardioids in Polar Coordinates), Area in Polar Coordinates, Length of a Polar Curve.
Planar Curves and Parametrization, Parametric Derivative, Length of a Parametric Curve. Vectors: Vectors, Dot Product, Angle Between Two Vectors, Orthogonal Vectors, Cross Product, Parallel Vectors.
Lines in Space (Vector and parametric equations, Angle between lines), Planes (Vector and general equation in space), Angle between a line and a plane.
